title: ScanTwin catalogue, change list v1.1 (after simulator review)
author: team bioengineer

F15.Threshold source: Team proposal, checked with simulator (Cho/Cr shifts by 1 SD at a ratio of about 0.3)
F15.Note: Limit depends on the processing pipeline. It is valid for a fit without residual-water removal. Re-test if water removal (HLSVD) is added.

F19.QC metric: Change in displaced voxel fraction between baseline and follow-up
F19.FAIL if: Different sequence or RF bandwidth without harmonisation
F19.Note: PRESS at 3 T always gives about 12% displacement. This is a standing limitation of the method, not a session failure.

F22.Note: Removed from the gates; becomes a gate once water-referenced data exist. Measurement card: ratios only; creatine assumed stable. A change in X/Cr may come from Cr. Absolute water-referenced values are needed to rule this out.

F08.Note: Needs the individual transients (single averages). N/A when only the averaged spectrum is stored, as in the StarterPack.

F23.Note: Same as F08. Needs individual transients; N/A on averaged data.

F14.Note: CRLB measures precision, not bias. It stays below 20% even when faults shift Cho/Cr by 5 SD. Never use it as the only fit check; always combine it with F12 (linewidth), F13 (SNR) and F18 (fit residual).

new_rows.Effect on the result: Lower signal and more water leakage; Cho/Cr biased (−0.12 in simulation) while the fit looks fine
new_rows.QC metric: Reference signal amplitude vs phantom baseline
new_rows.Threshold source: Team proposal; effect size from simulator
new_rows.What physically happens: RF pulses deliver the wrong flip angle, so excitation, refocusing and water suppression are all off
new_rows.Context that raises the risk: Large head, high field, voxel far from coil centre

data_contract: Store individual MRS transients (NIfTI-MRS dimension DIM_DYN). Needed for F08 and F23, and the only way to tell frequency drift (fixable by alignment) from a bad shim (not fixable).
decision_rules_step3_addition: A gate whose input data are missing is shown as N/A with a reason, never as FAIL.
ui: Scan context input on the ScanTwin tab, from the Context factors sheet; it changes only warnings and fix advice, never the limits.
